description: Search and filter Ashby job postings across tracked companies (or any live Ashby company slug) using canonical location normalization and scope classification.

city.description: Filter by canonical city/metro name or alias (e.g. 'NYC' matches 'New York', 'SF' matches 'San Francisco').

company.description: Optional company slug (e.g. 'linear', 'ramp', 'cohere', 'ashby', 'influxdata', or any live Ashby board slug). Omit to search all tracked companies.

country.description: Filter by country name or ISO code (automatically normalized, e.g. 'USA', 'US', 'UK', 'CA', 'DE').

department.description: Case-insensitive substring match on department or team.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching jobs to return (default: 50).

query.description: Case-insensitive keyword search on job title, department, or team.

name: search_jobs
